notes:
Flame Graph: a map of where a render spends its time. wide bars are the slow parts, click one to zoom in. each bar is actually a full-width button. a clip carves the visible slice, so as samples land or you zoom, the edges slide instead of jumping.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
